$comment: coldpress-os enforcement hooks (action plan §4.4, WS1). Each event is wired to `node scripts/hooks/run.mjs <name>` — a thin dep-free runner that forwards to `coldpress hook <name>`; the logic lives in @coldpress/core and is unit-tested. Hooks honor COLDPRESS_OVERRIDE="<gate>:<reason>" (loudly logged) and support `coldpress hook <name> --explain`. More hooks (phase-gate, schema-validate, quality-gate, run-log, test-integrity) land as WS1 progresses.
